title: Plate 119 — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Engraving the mechanism
scenes.purpose: Engrave the connected system: the units wheel (the idea), the carry pinion, the tens wheel, the belt and the inspection rail.
visuals: Cool celadon porcelain plate #E4E9E7, fixed in place
Hatched bevel rings clipped to the wheel annuli
Green pointer shafts, then their separate heads

beats.development: The heading fades in while the rails, belt band and wheel rims begin drawing.
captions: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

beats.development: Hatching, tooth rings and the register card fill in. Wheel digits and captions appear after their containers are complete. Pointer heads appear at 1.20 s, when their shafts finish drawing.
captions: IV · INSPECTION RAIL — THE CONNECTED SYSTEM

scenes.title: Carry operation
scenes.purpose: One crank driver turns the units wheel 6→7→8→9→0. On the last step the carry moves the tens wheel one detent, and the belt slides the carriage along the rail.
visuals: Units wheel turns in four 36° detent steps
Belt teeth dashoffset follows the belt travel

beats.development: The driver goes 216°→360°. The register counts 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, and the carry happens on the 9→0 step.
Settled hold: the register reads 20 and every part is at rest.

findings: Motion is settled by 2.59 s, before the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: 2.59–3.00 s: final reading of the carried register.

notes: Background refreshed to a scene-dependent cool porcelain. No source frames matched, so no source evidence is used.
